summary.text: Named both among the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium and among the twelve suitors from Ithaca itself in Apollodorus' island catalogues — to be distinguished from the Amphimachus son of Nomion and the Epeian leader at Troy.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Amphimachus among the many suitors who consumed Odysseus' substance while the king was away, and again among the twelve wooers specifically from Ithaca itself — alongside Antinous, Pronous, Eurynomus, Amphialus, Promachus, and the rest.
